name: SGP40 VOC air quality sensor
description: Sensirion metal-oxide (MOx) gas sensor for volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in indoor air, with an I2C interface. It returns a 16-bit raw signal SRAW_VOC in ticks (proportional to the logarithm of the sensing layer's resistance, falling as VOCs rise) once per measurement command; Sensirion's Gas Index Algorithm on the host turns it into a 1-500 VOC Index. Chip runs on 1.7-3.6 V. Sold as: Adafruit SGP40 STEMMA QT breakout (PID 4829; 5-pin header VIN, 3.3V, GND, SCL, SDA, 3-5 V supply via an on-board regulator), I2C address 0x59 (fixed).
eli5: Sniffs the air for smells like paint, cleaning sprays or cooking fumes, so you can tell when the air in a room is getting stale.

pins.description: Supply, 3-5 V (use your board's logic voltage; an on-board regulator makes 3.3 V for the sensor)

supplierQuery: SGP40 VOC air quality sensor breakout I2C
buildNotes: Measure: write 0x26 0x0F followed by the humidity word + CRC and the temperature word + CRC, wait 30 ms, read 3 bytes: SRAW_VOC MSB, LSB, CRC.

Send 0x80 0x00 0xA2 0x66 0x66 0x93 (50 %RH, 25 °C, the datasheet defaults) to leave humidity compensation off, or real values from a humidity sensor: RH ticks = RH% x 65535 / 100, T ticks = (T°C + 45) x 65535 / 175.
CRC-8 after every word, poly 0x31, init 0xFF (0xBE 0xEF -> 0x92). A mismatch almost always means a loose SDA/SCL wire.
Measure about once a second (0.5-10 s allowed); the hotplate stays on between commands. Send 0x36 0x15 to switch the heater off. Discard the first reading if you use the raw signal directly.

SRAW_VOC is not a concentration: it falls as VOCs rise. Use Sensirion's Gas Index Algorithm for a 1-500 VOC Index (100 = this room's average over the last 24 h); it needs about a minute to start detecting events and about an hour to settle.
Power VIN from 3.3 V on an ESP32 or Pico: the SDA/SCL pull-ups go to VIN, so 5 V on VIN would put 5 V on the data lines.
Keep the sensor's opening uncovered and away from the regulator and microcontroller; never let condensation form on it (above 90 %RH).

driver.code:
# SGP40 VOC gas sensor (Sensirion SGP40), MicroPython driver.
# From the SGP40 datasheet v1.2 (Feb 2022), I2C address 0x59:
#   sgp40_measure_raw_signal 0x26 0x0F + RH word + CRC + T word + CRC, wait 30 ms, read 3 bytes
#   sgp40_execute_self_test  0x28 0x0E, wait 320 ms, read 3 bytes (0xD4xx = pass, 0x4Bxx = fail)
#   sgp4x_turn_heater_off    0x36 0x15 (back to idle)
# Every 16-bit word (sent or received) is followed by a CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF).
# The result is SRAW_VOC in ticks (0-65535), proportional to the logarithm of the sensing
# layer's resistance: it goes DOWN when VOCs go up. Turning it into a 1-500 VOC Index needs
# Sensirion's Gas Index Algorithm (github.com/Sensirion/gas-index-algorithm), not included here.
import time


def _crc8(data):
    crc = 0xFF
    for b in data:
        crc ^= b
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x31) & 0xFF if crc & 0x80 else (crc << 1) & 0xFF
    return crc


def _word(v):
    v = max(0, min(65535, int(v)))
    b = bytes([v >> 8, v & 0xFF])
    return b + bytes([_crc8(b)])


class SGP40:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x59):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        time.sleep_ms(1)  # power-up time is at most 0.6 ms

    def _read_word(self, cmd, wait_ms):
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, cmd)
        time.sleep_ms(wait_ms)
        d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 3)
        if _crc8(d[0:2]) != d[2]:
            raise OSError('SGP40 CRC mismatch: check the wiring')
        return (d[0] << 8) | d[1]

    def measure_raw(self, humidity=None, temperature=None):
        """One raw measurement, SRAW_VOC in ticks.

        Pass the air's relative humidity (%) and temperature (°C), e.g. from an SHT31 or
        SHT40, to switch on the chip's humidity compensation. Without them the datasheet
        default values (50 %RH, 25 °C) are sent, which leaves compensation off.
        Call about once a second; the heater stays on between calls.
        """
        if humidity is None or temperature is None:
            rh_ticks, t_ticks = 0x8000, 0x6666  # datasheet defaults: compensation disabled
        else:
            rh_ticks = round(humidity * 65535 / 100)
            t_ticks = round((temperature + 45) * 65535 / 175)
        cmd = b'\x26\x0f' + _word(rh_ticks) + _word(t_ticks)
        return self._read_word(cmd, 30)  # max execution time 30 ms

    def self_test(self):
        """Run the built-in hotplate/MOX self-test. Returns True if it passed."""
        return (self._read_word(b'\x28\x0e', 320) >> 8) == 0xD4

    def heater_off(self):
        """Switch the hotplate off and return to idle (about 34 uA)."""
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, b'\x36\x15')
        time.sleep_ms(1)

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from sgp40 import SGP40

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = SGP40(i2c)
sensor.measure_raw()  # the first reading after switch-on is discarded
while True:
    raw = sensor.measure_raw(humidity=50, temperature=25)
    print('SRAW_VOC=%d' % raw)
    time.sleep(1)
